title.rendered: Recruitment Solutions to Grow Your Business

content.rendered:
Recruitment is challenging, considering the scope of tasks it involves. But what if we told you that you could automate job posting, applicant scoring, candidate screening, and numerous other procedures?

The key to accelerating the hiring process is using recruitment solutions. These techs are in high demand, and their market size is constantly growing. IMARC Group projects the global recruitment solution market to reach $2.8 billion by 2027, expanding from $2 billion in 2021.

With these innovations in place, businesses can experience numerous benefits, which we’ll discuss in today’s article. We’ll also tell you about the most helpful tools and services to streamline recruitment processes.

Recruitment Solutions and Their Benefits Explained

Recruitment solution is software that helps businesses streamline the entire hiring process for a growing team. It covers everything from locating candidates and evaluating their resumes to appointing interviews and sending job offers.

Such software also offers reporting and analytics features. It helps companies better allocate their budget, know which and how many candidates they need, and gain insights to improve their hiring procedures.

Compared to the manual execution of recruiting tasks, having an HR software solution means getting the following advantages:

  • Speeding up the hiring process. You can instantly assess and connect with candidates through a recruitment software solution.
  • Keeping all data in one place. You no longer need to go through tons of papers since you can review all the necessary information about candidates on the recruiting platform.
  • Reducing administrative work. You can automatically post vacancies on various job boards, schedule interviews in a digital calendar, and more: everything with a few clicks.
  • Finding better candidates. With all applicant data at your fingertips, you can filter out unsuitable candidates and select the best experts for your team. HR manager functions is a responsibility of several departments or employees
  • Improving internal communication. With a unified recruiting system, you and your employees will always be up to date on all recruiting tasks.

All these recruitment software solution benefits eventually lead to better overall performance and profitability, supporting your business scaling plan effectively.

5 Common Recruitment Challenges and Their Solutions

As we have already mentioned, hiring is a complex and time-consuming procedure. Let’s look at typical recruiting issues and how an HR recruitment solution can handle them.

  1. Niche-specific talent shortage. Finding a suitable employee will be challenging if you need a niche specialist. And if you don’t know where to look for such experts, it will be even harder. The good news is that with the recruiting solution, you can use the multiposting features and advertise your vacancies on multiple platforms, increasing your chances of finding the perfect candidate.
  2. Recruitment outside your country. You are likely unaware of the platforms local job seekers use when you’re looking for specialists in a foreign country. Recruitment solutions featuring recruitment automation tools can suggest the most popular local job boards to you.
  3. No HR department. Startups and small businesses usually don’t have a separate HR department. Accordingly, they don’t have professional recruiters to hire candidates. But with applicant tracking system (ATS) or human resources information system (HRIS) solutions, you can become an HRIS consultant and streamline your hiring processes.
  4. Uncertainty about where to start. Sure, recruiting involves numerous tasks, and some businesses may be confused about those. Having a recruitment solution means organizing all hiring-related activities gradually.
  5. Poor collaboration. Keeping all employees in the company updated on your hiring activities can be difficult, especially if you do it manually. Yet, with the recruiting system, you can improve communication and cooperation in the office.

Main Recruitment Services Overview

When hiring employees, you probably wonder how to do it best. Look at the main recruiting services that an HR recruitment solution can offer.

  • Direct hire recruiting. Such a service is necessary for finding candidates for difficult-to-fill positions or when your in-house recruiters cannot handle the increased volume of work.
  • Contract or temporary recruiting. This service allows for hiring candidates on demand for a particular period.
  • Contract-to-hire recruiting. This service is best for fast hiring when the scope of work is hard to predict or when an employer wants a trial period before hiring applicants.
  • Hybrid retained search services. It involves engaging a recruiter for a single down payment and paying the remaining amount after the specialist is successfully placed.
  • Retained search services. It involves engaging one HR firm to handle your recruitment processes.
  • Contingency recruiting services. These services include engaging an HR firm to look for the candidates and help you throughout the entire hiring process until concluding a deal.

Innovative Recruitment Tools to Consider

Some tools can enhance your IT recruitment solution significantly. Here are the main ones:

  • AI sourcing. AI-based sourcing engines can help you find and score applicants much faster. These techs may analyze various criteria to find the matching candidates and adjust search results following the indicated requirements.
  • Email engagement. You can analyze your job campaigns and automate your candidate reach by sending instant emails to job seekers through this tool.
  • Recruiting analytics. Use reporting and analytics tools to understand your candidate supply, email, and campaign performance better and facilitate objection processing. You can create an HR recruitment dashboard to track these KPIs in real time.

Obstacles a Recruiter May Face When Hiring in Another Country

When opting for recruitment process outsourcing, a recruiter may face various obstacles. One that we mentioned today is finding the most popular local job boards. Yet, there are several other challenges to tackle. Let’s discuss them in greater detail.

  • Cultural differences. When hiring employees in another country, you need to understand that a one-size-fits-all approach to organizing work processes won’t work. That’s why recruiters need to be aware of the different variations in hiring strategies considering such factors as the standard of living, working conditions, and level of education in a foreign country.
  • Increased competition. While a worldwide tech talent recruitment solution gives you access to an extensive talent pool, competition remains high. It’s especially critical given that you need to compete with local recruiters. Therefore, before outsourcing, carefully study the labor market in the country of your choice.
  • Communication barriers. Another obstacle you’ll have to deal with is potential problems in communicating with candidates. It may be due to the difference in time zones or language barriers. Thus, it’s best to choose countries with similar time zones and candidates with English language knowledge.

Mobilunity could successfully locate specialists for several software development projects in Japan. In 2020, our team found four dev specialists following the client’s requirements to work on an online music service. In 2021, we started cooperating with an innovative digital agency, for which we located a server-side application engineer.

You have two options to outsource your recruiting tasks: opting for a recruiting service or hiring a dedicated recruiter. Let’s look at these two approaches in more detail.
